0022600195.text: The San Antonio Spurs (6-2, 2nd in the Southwest, 5th in the West) are on a six-game winning streak and have gone 2-0 on the road, while the Portland Trail Blazers (6-1, 1st in the Northwest and 1st in the West) have won three straight and are 5-0 away from home. The Spurs won the 2025-26 regular-season series 2-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-1, including a 114-95 win in San Antonio on April 28, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. The Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), and the Trail Blazers are without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle).
